Derivations.name: CWE-1061: Insufficient Encapsulation -> CAPEC-13: Input Validation Deception -> MITRE ATT&CK T1048: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol -> ATM: Removable Media
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker exploits vulnerabilities in the USB interface to exfiltrate sensitive data such as user profiles or navigation data.

Derivations.name: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information -> CAPEC-28: Privilege Escalation -> MITRE ATT&CK T1106: Exploit Public-Facing Application -> ATM: Aftermarket, Customer, or Dealer Equipment
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker leverages a compromised smartphone connected via Bluetooth to access user profiles and other sensitive data on the infotainment system.

Derivations.name: CWE-15: External Control of System or Configuration Setting -> CAPEC-16: Attack on Confidentiality -> MITRE ATT&CK T1021.001: Remote Desktop Protocol -> ATM: Gather Target Information – from Vehicle
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker compromises the Wi-Fi module to gain access to the cloud backend, potentially leading to data breaches or manipulation of connected services.

Derivations.name: CWE-829: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere -> CAPEC-12: Supply Chain Compromise -> MITRE ATT&CK T1572: Protocol Tunneling -> ATM: Control of System
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker injects malicious CAN messages through the CAN transceiver, potentially affecting vehicle operations or safety systems.

Derivations.name: CWE-318: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information in Executable -> CAPEC-28: Privilege Escalation -> MITRE ATT&CK T1548.002: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: setuid and setgid -> ATM: Control of System
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker modifies the infotainment system's firmware in the Code Flash, leading to persistent malicious behavior or denial of service.

Derivations.name: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor -> CAPEC-29: Data Leakage -> MITRE ATT&CK T1552.001: Steal or Substitute Credentials: Plaintext Accesses and Information -> ATM: Access personal data
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker accesses and exfiltrates sensitive personal information stored in user profiles.

Derivations.name: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information -> CAPEC-30: Credential Access -> MITRE ATT&CK T1552.001: Steal or Substitute Credentials: Plaintext Accesses and Information -> ATM: Gather Target Information – from Other
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker steals or compromises the cryptographic keys stored in the infotainment system, enabling further attacks like unauthorized communication or firmware manipulation.

Derivations.name: CWE-15: External Control of System or Configuration Setting -> CAPEC-12: Supply Chain Compromise -> MITRE ATT&CK T1071.004: Application Layer Protocol: DNS -> ATM: Aftermarket, Customer, or Dealer Equipment
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker uses the OBD-II port with a malicious tool to gain unauthorized access to the vehicle's diagnostic systems or control modules.

Derivations.name: CWE-668: Exposure of Resource to an Insecure Default Condition -> CAPEC-634: Probe Audio and Video Peripherals -> MITRE ATT&CK T1123: Audio Capture -> ATM: Access personal data
Derivations.damage_scene: An attacker remotely activates the microphone to eavesdrop on conversations within the vehicle.

Details.Name: Data Exfiltration via USB
Details.Description: An attacker exploits vulnerabilities in the USB interface to exfiltrate sensitive data such as user profiles or navigation data.

Details.Name: Unauthorized Access to Smartphone Data
Details.Description: An attacker leverages a compromised smartphone connected via Bluetooth to access user profiles and other sensitive data on the infotainment system.

Details.Name: Unauthorized Access to Cloud Services
Details.Description: An attacker compromises the Wi-Fi module to gain access to the cloud backend, potentially leading to data breaches or manipulation of connected services.

Details.Name: Manipulation of Vehicle Network
Details.Description: An attacker injects malicious CAN messages through the CAN transceiver, potentially affecting vehicle operations or safety systems.

Details.Name: Firmware Tampering
Details.Description: An attacker modifies the infotainment system's firmware in the Code Flash, leading to persistent malicious behavior or denial of service.

Details.Name: Disclosure of PII
Details.Description: An attacker accesses and exfiltrates sensitive personal information stored in user profiles.

Details.Name: Compromise of Cryptographic Keys
Details.Description: An attacker steals or compromises the cryptographic keys stored in the infotainment system, enabling further attacks like unauthorized communication or firmware manipulation.

Details.Name: Unauthorized Diagnostic Access
Details.Description: An attacker uses the OBD-II port with a malicious tool to gain unauthorized access to the vehicle's diagnostic systems or control modules.

Details.Name: Eavesdropping
Details.Description: An attacker remotely activates the microphone to eavesdrop on conversations within the vehicle.
